name: Out of the Grey (Xuất Hôi Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Last Man in the File (Mạt Hàng Nhân)
bonuses.rule: while the raised standard stands, you gain +20 block rating as though you had raised the shield, and each blocked hit lets you shed 1 Wood poison stack and 1 Corpse Rot miasma stack (once every 3 s).

story: The banner, the cloth and the shield of the file of forty. Mục Hàn Nhạn holds all three. The shared-damage half is the closest line until targets-tl/geese-line exists.

name: Point of the File (Hàng Đầu Song Bảo)

bonuses.rule: you take 10 % less damage, and each block you make gives you a small ward.

story: The sword and the coat of the point, handed to each holder in turn. Mục Tân Vũ is the tenth to hold both.
